units.text: INT. GHOSTS - CONTINUOUS
Pointing to the hall.
No; there it hangs.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Let it be. He must come up now. I shall go and look for him myself.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: She goes out through the garden door.
Comes in from the hall.
Is not Mrs. Alving here?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: She has just gone down the garden.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: This is the most terrible night I ever went through.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes; isn't it a dreadful misfortune, sir?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Oh, don't talk about it! I can hardly bear to think of it.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: How can it have happened--?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Don't ask me, Miss Engstrand! How should I know? Do you, too--? Is it not enough that your father--?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: What about him?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Oh, he has driven me distracted--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Enters through the hall.
Your Reverence--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Turns round in terror.
Are you after me here, too?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes, strike me dead, but I must--! Oh, Lord! what am I saying? But this is a terrible ugly business, your Reverence.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Walks to and fro.
Alas! alas!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: What's the matter?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Why, it all came of this here prayer-meeting, you see.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Softly.
The bird's limed, my girl.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Aloud.
And to think it should be my doing that such a thing should be his Reverence's doing!
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: But I assure you, Engstrand--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: There wasn't another soul except your Reverence as ever laid a finger on the candles down there.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Stops.
So you declare. But I certainly cannot recollect that I ever had a candle in my hand.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: And I saw as clear as daylight how your Reverence took the candle and snuffed it with your fingers, and threw away the snuff among the shavings.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: And you stood and looked on?
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes; I saw it as plain as a pike-staff, I did.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: It's quite beyond my comprehension. Besides, it has never been my habit to snuff candles with my fingers.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: And terrible risky it looked, too, that it did! But is there such a deal of harm done after all, your Reverence?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Walks restlessly to and fro.
Oh, don't ask me!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Walks with him.
And your Reverence hadn't insured it, neither?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Continuing to walk up and down.
No, no, no; I have told you so.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Following him.
Not insured! And then to go straight away down and set light to the whole thing! Lord, Lord, what a misfortune!
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Wipes the sweat from his forehead.
